## Problem and resulting behaviour
Explain the trigger, previous result and corrected result.

## Linked issue
Use `Closes #number` only when merging completes its acceptance criteria.

## Changes
Explain the relevant files and decisions.

## Validation
List checks actually run, environment and observed outcomes. Explicitly list pending checks. Syntax CI alone does not establish functional acceptance.

## Peer review
- [ ] A different teammate reviewed the diff and test evidence.
- [ ] Feedback has been resolved and affected checks rerun.
- [ ] No personal data, credentials or generated uploads are included.

## Conflicts
If a real conflict occurred, record affected files, agreed resolution and retest. Otherwise write "No merge conflicts occurred."
